addendum.decision: Accepted precise control-local admission, explicit registry-to-control fanout interval, and separate real C-reclaim retirement point. This clarifies historical facts versus later facade authority and does not waive the initial S4R-03 defect.

source_assessment: Only product change since final2 is CapabilityAndroidLifetimeControl.beginJoin checking fault==0 under existing control lock before native consumer assertion. Existing exact key, one-shot, terminal RETIRE and actual common Task.value guards remain. No lock spans C.

A control-local fault latched before this admission rejects native bookkeeping. Registry fault can precede delivery to that control; that documented interval may still record genuine Task-return/RETIRE bookkeeping but cannot permit native reclaim.

Registry.reclaimEndpoint and quarantineAll serialize on the same admission mutex. Registry fault winning before real C reclaim blocks it. Actual C OK winning first is a completed historical endpoint fact; later exact scalar evidence/Swift endpoint removal are valid.

That fact is distinct from facade finalization. In the probed opposite ordering, global fault quarantines the facade, final finish returns quarantine, actual resources remain retained and capacity remains occupied. No general proof of every possible later facade-stage race is claimed by this bounded review.

Passed original S4R-03 sequence: real completed nonfinal RETIRE, real duplicate progress invariant, actual C callback fault/fanout, then common final finish. retirement_done1, consumer_joined0, final quarantine and endpoint/resource/capacity retention. Only this derived scenario ran in each of these three receipts.
